note: a three joint chain skinning a four ring tube with joint binding positions that make the rest pose the identity (bone matrices and skinned positions of all 16 coordinates compared with X_ITE 16.6.0: its joint matrices exact from the node, its skinned positions by its own shader formula on those matrices), then bent, moved and scaled; the segment and the site ride their joints. Pictures compared as silhouettes.
scope: skinNormal, skinBindingCoords and skinBindingNormals are stored; neither engine uses them (X_ITE 16.6.0 reads skinCoord only): the skin normals follow the bone matrices in the shader (X_ITE blends the inverse transpose per joint, the same for rotations, different under non-uniform joint scale)

only IndexedFaceSet and IndexedTriangleSet skin shapes are skinned (a vertex's coordinate index is known); a vertex with more than 8 joint influences keeps the 8 largest, X_ITE has no limit; the viewpoints, joints, segments and sites lists are references (not drawn twice)
